description: This file defines a Java interface 'PolicyQueryCommand' that extends 'PolicyCommand' and represents a query command for policies in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes a method to set headers and a default method to get the category.

classes.name: PolicyQueryCommand
classes.description: A generic interface for querying the state of policies, extending the PolicyCommand interface.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the DittoHeaders for the command, returning the command object for chaining.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, specifically 'QUERY'.
